The vendor shall erect the tent structure; perform necessary electrical connections of lights, coolers, f ans and other electrical equipment supplied by the vendor, at least 2 days before the scheduled progr amme i.e. by 29/11/2026 positively. 4. Signed Integrity Pact as per the attached in GeM Bid Documents under(Generic) should be signed, stamped and uploaded back in the GeM bidding portal. 8.
